# Controlled task-state evaluation fixtures

`controlled_reference.json` is sanitized simulation evidence generated by
`model_learner.learn.task_state.run_task_state_experiment()` with its defaults:
seeds 0–4, 400 tasks per seed, state-signal and null-signal scenarios, 60% frozen
training prefix, 30-second horizon and 300 paired task-bootstrap draws.
Per-run predictions are omitted; all scores, calibration bins, counts, exclusions,
ablations, paired intervals and methodology are retained. No coding agent ran.

The generator emits public invented identities, generic task groups/models and
consistent synthetic checkpoint projections. It samples state before eventual
acceptance and never supplies realized outcomes as features. These examples are
simulated data, never real or benchmark observations. No private payloads,
transcripts, credentials, commands or filesystem contents are used.
